vibe‑dump

A dump of tiny static web experiments.

Lotus OS

A black-and-gold-on-purple toy desktop cut with Thai temple ornament — folders, resizable windows, a terminal, and one window holding a whole other app from this gallery — until you run reveal.run and the camera pulls back off the screen to find the monitor sitting on a cluttered workbench, 3D printer and all.

Opus 5

art

Elliptic Rank

An interactive tour of elliptic curves — the chord-and-tangent group law, torsion, and what rank actually means — ending at the rank-31 record curve of August 2026, whose 31 witness points you can verify in exact big-integer arithmetic.

Opus 5

tutorial

Ideographic Ink

CSS text-box-trim has two values only Japanese fonts can answer — ideographic and ideographic-ink. An interactive tour of the em box, the character face, and the animations you get once you read those metrics yourself.

tutorial

Kanji Lathe

A parametric type foundry for the 1,000 most common kanji: stroke-order-aware skeletons run through a deformation pipeline, with crown shyness, region compression and a live TrueType export.

Opus 5

toolart

Eclipse Clear Skies

Live clear-sky forecaster for the 12 Aug 2026 total solar eclipse over western Iceland: exact per-location totality times computed from NASA's Besselian elements, blended multi-model cloud forecasts at each spot's own mid-eclipse minute, live doppler radar and IR satellite overlays, and a ranked list of the best places to stand — refreshing itself as new model runs land.

SloshOS

Frutiger-aero toy desktop where every window is liquid-filled glass — a duck pond, a glitter flask, a blue lava lamp and a ring clock that all slosh when dragged.

Abyssal Angler

The other end of the line from Abyssal Ascent: skipper a night boat over the same seven-zone abyss and steer your hook down past the easy shallows toward things with more teeth. Fish too heavy for your tackle snap the line, so land what you can, fill the salvage sonar, and haul up ever-better rods — hand line, abyssal winch, hadal cable, and finally the Godhook — until you can reach the Cradle and hook the one catch the fleet should have left alone.

Token Foundry

A Factorio-like about running an LLM inference company: tokenize prompts, prefill them into KV-cache blocks, belt the cache to bandwidth-bound decode pods, sell output tokens — then scrape data, train bigger checkpoints, and keep the megawatts and cooling ahead of the batch size.

mewlang

A tiny functional language evaluated by equality saturation: programs compile to a propagator network of e-graph cells, animated round by round with an interactive tutorial.

tutorial

Abyssal Ascent

Hatch in the vent-lit cradle ten kilometres down and devour your way up through seven depth zones, evolving ten times over — larva, ribbon eel, viperfish, gulper, sea serpent, bone shark, leviathan, and finally The Kraken. The residents fight back: octopuses blind you with ink, rays discharge, anglerfish reel you in, orcas and sperm whales hunt you on sight. Reach the surface as a kraken and the fishing fleet stops being a hazard and starts being food — until they send something with a thicker hull.

Busy Beaver Basins

A guided tour into the busy beaver problem, ending inside the 3-D state graph of a Turing machine run on a cyclic tape: one amber cone for every configuration that halts, cyan cones for the loops, and the blank tape's own run hanging off it. Raw WebGL.
